solidigm-p5520-4k-qd16-latency-derived.reason: AUDIT-01 AUD-013 (REMEDIATION-01, 2026-11-27): Little's law needs the mean number of outstanding I/Os and a steady state. The primary source (footnote [7], re-read 2026-11-27) gives fio, 4 KB, QD16 and the system, but neither the job count, nor whether QD16 is per job or total, nor runtime, preconditioning or steady state. The derivation is therefore not established; withheld from publication (arithmetic kept below). Earlier: input is the 233,700 IOPS (4 KiB, QD16) documented in the cited Solidigm brief (review M-2). Value stored at full precision (16 / 233700 s = 68.4638… µs) instead of the extraction's rounded 68.5 µs (calculated-value oracle, tolerance 1e-12).

patch.protocol: Rules cited are those of the current TOP500 Linpack page, not dated 1993; the 1993 run used LINPACK. Rmax as listed in the TOP500 list: best LINPACK performance achieved (for problem size Nmax). Rules stated on the current TOP500 Linpack page (https://www.top500.org/project/linpack/): LU factorisation with partial pivoting, operation count 2/3 n^3 + O(n^2) double-precision flops; excludes Strassen-type fast multiplication, solving in lower than full 64-bit precision then refining iteratively, and integer emulation of floating point. Hardware: the listed system and core count. Nmax, software stack and number of runs are not given on the list page.
